feeds.title: SnowPaw Store Blog
feeds.description: Explore news on Mushing, Sled dog races, Gear and Equipment reviews, Dog Care, and Upcoming events. The Snowpaw Store prides itself in carefully securing some of the best sled dog-related products from around the world and bringing them to the European market.

feeds.title: Reitter's Block Blog
feeds.description: Reitter's Block is a collection of musings by a 30-something Alaskan Female, focusing mainly on topics of Alaska such as Iditarod and Tourism. Photography and Disney Parks are also popular topics. Toni Reitter is a Photographer, Radio Host, and Mushing Enthusiast based in Alaska.

feeds.title: Seeing Double Sled Dog Racing Blog
feeds.description: Seeing Double Sled Dog Racing is a blog by identical twins and inspirational adventure-seeking women Kristy and Anna Berington. This blog recounts their journey and accomplishments at The Iditarod Dog Sledding Race 2022. Read more to follow along their and their Dog team's adventures.

feeds.title: Black Spruce Dog Sledding Blog
feeds.description: Black Spruce Dog Sledding Blog is essentially a Journal documenting Husband-Wife duo Jeff & Kattijo Deeter's experiences and stories on their road to the Iditarod Sled Dog Race 2022. Black Spruce Dog Sledding is a Dog Touring Company owned and operated by the husband-and-wife team, offering excellent outdoor activities in Alaska.

feeds.title: Bush Alaska Expeditions Blog
feeds.description: The Bush Alaska Expeditions Blog is dedicated to showing you the lifestyle of our friendly Alaskan Huskies that live, love, and work in the Alaska, Yukon Wilderness. We live in one of the most remote locations left on earth which include the Yukon Charley Rivers National Preserve, the 70-Mile River, and the 40-Mile Country.

feeds.title: Snowy Owl Sled Dog Tours Blog
feeds.description: Read the Snowy Owl Sled Dog Tours Blog to catch up on adoption updates and discover what it's like to go on a tour and work for us. Snowy Owl Sled Dog Tours offers both winter and summer tour experiences, including four winter dog sled tours, a summer dryland Adventure Dog Carting tour, and kennel tours.

feeds.title: I Was a Sled Dog Blog
feeds.description: I Was a Sled Dog is the Author's personal journey of advocating for sled dogs used and exploited in the commercial and racing industries. Learn more about stories from adopters and foster homes who are documenting, through words and images, these chapters of a Sled Dog's life.

feeds.title: A Life of Dogs Blog
feeds.description: Explore, news, anecdotes, and inspiring stories of mushers and their sled dogs from the Iditarod Sled Dog Race 2022. A Life of Dogs is a podcast that explores the remarkable relationships that we have created with dogs. Our podcast shares canine and human interest stories and sheds light on some mesmerizing connections between humans and dogs.

feeds.title: Shady Pines Sled Dogs Blog
feeds.description: Discover insightful tips and tricks related to Sled Dog races. Dog Training, How to Build a Dog Team and a range of other resources in this blog by Sally Manikian. Sally is musher with extensive backcountry experience through almost a decade of natural resource management. Sally and the dogs spend the fall and winter training in Upton Maine.

feeds.title: Petter Karlsson Blog
feeds.description: Petter Karlsson is one of Europe's top dog mushers. He competes at the highest level of the sport, driving a team of Alaskan huskies thousands of miles across some of the harshest terrain on the planet. Stay up to date with our training and racing. Get exclusive behind-the-scenes access to the workings of a champion sled dog kennel.
